tables.name: run
ddl: CREATE TABLE run(run_dir TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(instr(run_dir, '\') = 0 AND substr(run_dir, 1, 1) <> '/' AND ('/' || run_dir || '/') NOT GLOB '*/../*'), receipt_schema TEXT NOT NULL, source_sha TEXT, executable_sha256 TEXT CHECK(length(executable_sha256) = 64 AND executable_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), argv_sha256 TEXT CHECK(length(argv_sha256) = 64 AND argv_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), attempt INTEGER, build_type TEXT, role_id TEXT, outcome TEXT NOT NULL, exit_code INTEGER, git_state TEXT, error TEXT, limits TEXT CHECK(json_valid(limits)), admission TEXT CHECK(json_valid(admission)), dirty_outside TEXT CHECK(json_valid(dirty_outside)), store TEXT CHECK(json_valid(store)), started_utc TEXT, wall_seconds REAL, sampled_peak_tree_rss_bytes INTEGER, minimum_system_free_bytes INTEGER, owned_processes TEXT CHECK(json_valid(owned_processes)), ownership_scope TEXT, logs TEXT CHECK(json_valid(logs)), key_order TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(key_order)), extra TEXT CHECK(json_valid(extra)), file_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(file_sha256) = 64 AND file_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), PRIMARY KEY(run_dir)) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE INDEX ix_run_executable_sha256 ON run(executable_sha256);
CREATE INDEX ix_run_argv_sha256 ON run(argv_sha256);
CREATE INDEX ix_run_outcome ON run(outcome);

tables.name: run_command

tables.name: run_start
ddl: CREATE TABLE run_start(run_dir TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(instr(run_dir, '\') = 0 AND substr(run_dir, 1, 1) <> '/' AND ('/' || run_dir || '/') NOT GLOB '*/../*'), file_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(file_sha256) = 64 AND file_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), doc TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(doc)), PRIMARY KEY(run_dir)) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID;

tables.name: pin
ddl: CREATE TABLE pin(holder_path TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(instr(holder_path, '\') = 0 AND substr(holder_path, 1, 1) <> '/' AND ('/' || holder_path || '/') NOT GLOB '*/../*'), pointer TEXT NOT NULL, pin_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(pin_kind IN ('input', 'locked', 'fields-manifest', 'rule-template', 'exe', 'binding', 'receipt-binding', 'receipt-log', 'spec-digest', 'ledger-head', 'wave-manifest', 'stage-receipt', 'field-payload', 'field-registry', 'field-source')), target_path TEXT, target_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(target_sha256) = 64 AND target_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), PRIMARY KEY(holder_path, pointer)) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TRIGGER trial_line_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON trial_line BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'trial_line is append-only'); END;

views.name: pin_status
views.sql: CREATE VIEW pin_status AS SELECT p.holder_path AS holder_path, p.pointer AS pointer, p.pin_kind AS pin_kind, p.target_path AS target_path, p.target_sha256 AS target_sha256, a.sha256 AS artifact_sha256, a.sha_source AS sha_source, CASE WHEN p.target_path IS NULL OR (p.pin_kind = 'field-source' AND a.path_key IS NULL) THEN 'unresolved' WHEN a.path_key IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN a.sha256 <> p.target_sha256 THEN 'stale' WHEN a.sha_source = 'declared' THEN 'declared' ELSE 'ok' END AS state FROM pin AS p LEFT JOIN artifact AS a ON a.path_key = p.target_path;
